instruction: I want to increase readability of italic text. Please change the font size of all italicized words to 13 points.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing italic text size to 13pt. Verified document has 21 italic runs at size 12pt (152400 twips). Evaluator checks all italic text is size 13.
